description: Use this when the user wants to compare several businesses of a kind or find one that can help: it finds them near a place and calls them with the same goal, from 1 to 100. Examples: "call 3 mechanics near Plano, TX for front brake prices", "ask every pharmacy near 75024 when they close", "call hair salons in Dallas until one has a Saturday 10am slot" (stop_after=1). The server paces it (concurrency at a time), waits for business hours, and stops early with stop_after or max_spend_usd. Returns a batch_id: follow it with get_batch. Places this account called in the last 14 days are skipped (exclude_called=false to include). To get MORE places for the same request, call again with batch_id (paging; never repeats a place). For more than 10 places it returns a preview first: show the user the list and cost, then repeat with confirm=true. dry_run=true always previews. Put everything a business might ask in details and if_asked so dozens of calls don't each need you mid-call.
